tr.sahih: The Inevitable Reality -
tr.pickthall: The Reality!

tr.sahih: What is the Inevitable Reality?
tr.pickthall: What is the Reality?

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!

tr.sahih: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
tr.pickthall: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.

tr.sahih: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
tr.pickthall: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.

ayahs.text: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

tr.sahih: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
tr.pickthall: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,

ayahs.text: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ

tr.sahih: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
tr.pickthall: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.

tr.sahih: Then do you see of them any remains?
tr.pickthall: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ

tr.sahih: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
tr.pickthall: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,

ayahs.text: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً

tr.sahih: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
tr.pickthall: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship
tr.pickthall: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

ayahs.text: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ

words.gloss: and would be conscious of it

tr.sahih: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
tr.pickthall: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.

ayahs.text: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ

tr.sahih: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
tr.pickthall: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

ayahs.text: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً

tr.sahih: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
tr.pickthall: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,

tr.sahih: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
tr.pickthall: Then, on that day will the Event befall.

tr.sahih: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
tr.pickthall: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.

ayahs.text: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ

tr.sahih: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
tr.pickthall: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.

ayahs.text: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ

tr.sahih: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
tr.pickthall: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.

ayahs.text: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ

tr.sahih: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
tr.pickthall: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!

tr.sahih: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
tr.pickthall: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.

tr.sahih: So he will be in a pleasant life -
tr.pickthall: Then he will be in blissful state

tr.sahih: In an elevated garden,
tr.pickthall: In a high garden

tr.sahih: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
tr.pickthall: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.

ayahs.text: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ

tr.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
tr.pickthall: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.

ayahs.text: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ

tr.sahih: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
tr.pickthall: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book

tr.sahih: And had not known what is my account.
tr.pickthall: And knew not what my reckoning!

tr.sahih: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.
tr.pickthall: Oh, would that it had been death!

tr.sahih: My wealth has not availed me.
tr.pickthall: My wealth hath not availed me,

tr.sahih: Gone from me is my authority."
tr.pickthall: My power hath gone from me.

tr.sahih: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
tr.pickthall: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him

tr.sahih: Then into Hellfire drive him.
tr.pickthall: And then expose him to hell-fire

ayahs.text: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ

tr.sahih: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
tr.pickthall: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.

ayahs.text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,
tr.pickthall: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,

tr.sahih: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
tr.pickthall: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.

tr.sahih: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
tr.pickthall: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,

tr.sahih: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
tr.pickthall: Nor any food save filth

tr.sahih: None will eat it except the sinners.
tr.pickthall: Which none but sinners eat.

tr.sahih: So I swear by what you see
tr.pickthall: But nay! I swear by all that ye see

tr.sahih: And what you do not see
tr.pickthall: And all that ye see not

tr.sahih: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
tr.pickthall: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.

ayahs.text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
tr.pickthall: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!

ayahs.text: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
tr.pickthall: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!

tr.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

tr.sahih: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
tr.pickthall: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,

tr.sahih: We would have seized him by the right hand;
tr.pickthall: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand

tr.sahih: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
tr.pickthall: And then severed his life-artery,

ayahs.text: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ

tr.sahih: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
tr.pickthall: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.

tr.sahih: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).

tr.sahih: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
tr.pickthall: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).

tr.sahih: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.

tr.sahih: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is absolute truth.

tr.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr.pickthall: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
